note: tray student, per-step CNN with a chunk head (build8_tray_student.md): inputs ONLY top + wrist RGB (288 px, tray drawn at the goal) and q, qdot (12); ResNet18 (ImageNet, frozen BN) to layer3 per camera -> 32 spatial-softmax keypoints + 64-d pool; MLP 512-512 -> 10 x 6 joint targets (20 ms each) as (target - q at the query), mean / std normalised per (step, joint); masked L1; one query per 0.1 s, the first 5 targets executed (no ensembling)
